00108 void PartBuffer::partitionImpulse(Buffer const& original)
00109 {
00110     for(int i = 0; i < original.getNumChannels(); i++)
00111     {
00112         partitionImpulseChannel(original, i);
00113     }
00114 }

00116 void PartBuffer::partitionImpulseChannel(Buffer const& original, const int channel)
00117 {
00118     const float *bufferSamples;
00119     long impulseLength;
00120 
00121     bufferSamples = original.getDataReadOnly(channel);
00122     impulseLength = original.size();
00123         
00124     long fftSize = this->fftSize;
00125     long fftSizeHalved = fftSize / 2;
00126         
00127     long startPoint = this->startPoint;
00128     long endPoint = this->endPoint;
00129     long length = this->length;
00130     long numSamples;
00131     
00132     if (length && length < impulseLength)
00133         impulseLength = length; 
00134     if (endPoint && endPoint < impulseLength)
00135         impulseLength = endPoint;
00136     impulseLength -= startPoint;
00137     if (impulseLength < 0) impulseLength = 0;
00138     
00139     int numPartitions = impulseLength / fftSizeHalved;
00140     if (impulseLength % fftSizeHalved) numPartitions++;
00141     
00142     if (numPartitions * fftSizeHalved > this->bufferSize) 
00143         numPartitions = this->bufferSize / fftSizeHalved;
00144     
00145     float *bufferTemp1 = partTempBuffer.getData(); // this->Part_Temp.realp;
00146     float *impulseReal = getDataReal(channel);
00147     float *impulseImag = getDataImag(channel);
00148         
00149     DSPSplitComplex bufferTemp2;
00150     
00151     for (int i = 0; i < numPartitions; i++)
00152     {
00153         int bufferPos = i * fftSizeHalved;
00154         bufferTemp2.realp = impulseReal + (bufferPos);
00155         bufferTemp2.imagp = impulseImag + (bufferPos);
00156         
00157         // For proper ampwarping etc. - get two partitions - take FFTs of both - clip - ifft and overlap with hannging window
00158         
00159         if (impulseLength >= (bufferPos + fftSizeHalved)) numSamples = fftSizeHalved;
00160         else numSamples = impulseLength - bufferPos;
00161         
00162         // copy real time domain samples to Buffer_Temp1
00163         memcpy(bufferTemp1, bufferSamples + startPoint + bufferPos, sizeof(float) * numSamples);
00164         
00165         // zero pad the rest of Buffer_Temp1
00166         for (int j = numSamples; j < partTempBuffer.size(); j++)
00167             bufferTemp1[j] = 0;
00168         
00169         // Do FFT Straight Into Position...
00170         
00171         fftEngine->fft(bufferTemp2, bufferTemp1);
00172     }
00173         
00174     this->numPartitions = numPartitions;
00175 }

00233 void PartConvolveUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00234 {
00235     const int numSamples = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00236     
00237     vFloat *outputSamples = (vFloat*)uGenOutput.getSampleData();        
00238     vFloat *inputSamples = (vFloat*)inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00239         
00240     DSPSplitComplex impulseTemp, bufferTemp;
00241     DSPSplitComplex impulse;
00242         
00243     impulse.realp = partImpulse_.getDataReal(channel);
00244     impulse.imagp = partImpulse_.getDataImag(channel);
00245     
00246     //LOCAL_DECLARE(float* const, fftBuffersMemorySamples);
00247     LOCAL_DECLARE(float* const, fftTempBufferSamples);
00248     LOCAL_DECLARE(float* const, inputBufferSamples);
00249     
00250     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, tillNextFFT);
00251     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, rwPointer1);
00252     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, rwPointer2);
00253     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, fftOffset);
00254         
00255     LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSize);
00256     const int fftSizeHalved = fftSize >> 1 ;
00257     const int fftSizeHalvedOver4 = fftSizeHalved >> 2;
00258     LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeLog2);
00259     const int fftSizeHalvedLog2 = fftSizeLog2-1;
00260     LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, bufferSize);
00261     LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeOver4);
00262                          
00263     DSPSplitComplex fftTemp;
00264     fftTemp.realp = fftTempBufferSamples;
00265     fftTemp.imagp = fftTemp.realp + fftSizeHalved;
00266     
00267     const int Partitions = partImpulse_.numPartitions;
00268     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, bufPosition);
00269     
00270     // Schedule Stuff
00271     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, partitionsDone);
00272     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, scheduleCounter);
00273     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, lastPart);
00274     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, validPart);
00275     
00276     // FFT Stuff    
00277     LOCAL_DECLARE(FFTEngineInternal*, fftEngine);
00278     
00279     LOCAL_DECLARE(vFloat **, fftBuffers);
00280     vFloat *tempvPointer1, *tempvPointer2;
00281     
00282     int numSamplesRemaining = numSamples >> 2;
00283     
00284     LOCAL_DECLARE(vFloat, scaleMult);
00285     vFloat zero = {0.,0.,0.,0.};
00286     
00287     if (resetAll) {
00288         // FFT Related
00289         int N = 1 << (fftSizeLog2 - 3);
00290         int randomStart;
00291         while (N <= (randomStart = std::rand() / (RAND_MAX / N))); // perhaps use Ran088 here?
00292         
00293         tillNextFFT = randomStart;
00294         rwPointer1 = (fftSizeHalved >> 2) - tillNextFFT;
00295         rwPointer2 = rwPointer1 + tillNextFFT;
00296         fftOffset = 0;
00297         
00298         tempvPointer1 = (vFloat*)fftTempBufferSamples;
00299         for (int i = 0; i < fftSizeOver4; i++)  tempvPointer1[i] = zero;
00300         
00301         tempvPointer1 = (vFloat*)fftBuffersMemorySamples;
00302         for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++)       tempvPointer1[i] = zero;
00303                 
00304         // Scheduling Related
00305         bufPosition = 0;
00306         scheduleCounter = 0;
00307         partitionsDone = 0;
00308         lastPart = 0;
00309         
00310         // How Many Partitions To Do...
00311         validPart = 1;
00312         
00313         this->resetAll = 0;
00314     }
00315     
00316     while (numSamplesRemaining > 0) {
00317         // Check whether there will be another FFT this vector
00318         int loop;
00319         int fftTest = numSamplesRemaining - tillNextFFT;
00320         if (fftTest > 0) {
00321             loop = tillNextFFT;
00322             numSamplesRemaining -= tillNextFFT;
00323             tillNextFFT = 0;
00324         } else {
00325             loop = numSamplesRemaining;
00326             tillNextFFT -= numSamplesRemaining;
00327             numSamplesRemaining = 0;
00328         }
00329         
00330         // Load input into buffer (twice) and output from the output buffer
00331         // Put it straight into the right place - using overlap save it would seem....
00332         for (int i = 0; i < loop; i++)
00333         {
00334             *(fftBuffers[0] + rwPointer1) = *inputSamples; 
00335             *(fftBuffers[1] + rwPointer2) = *inputSamples;
00336             
00337             *outputSamples++ = *(fftBuffers[3] + rwPointer1);   
00338             
00339             rwPointer1++;
00340             rwPointer2++;
00341             inputSamples++;
00342         }
00343         
00344         // Work Loop
00345         
00346         if (partitionsDone >= validPart - 1) loop = 0;      // Check To See If there's more processing scheduled
00347         else loop = 1;
00348         scheduleCounter++;
00349         
00350         while (loop)
00351         {
00352             // How Many Partitions To Do....
00353             int numPartitionsToDo = (int)((float) ((scheduleCounter * (validPart - 1)) / (float) ((fftSizeHalved / numSamples) - 1)) - partitionsDone);
00354             if (scheduleCounter >= (fftSizeHalved / numSamples) - 1) 
00355                 numPartitionsToDo = (validPart - partitionsDone) - 1;
00356             
00357             // Calculate Buffer Wraparound
00358             int nextPart = lastPart;
00359             if (nextPart >= Partitions) nextPart = 0;           // Flip Round Buffer Immediately
00360             lastPart = nextPart + numPartitionsToDo;
00361             if (lastPart > Partitions) {                        // Flip Round In Middle
00362                 lastPart = Partitions;
00363                 numPartitionsToDo = lastPart - nextPart;
00364             }
00365             else loop = 0;                                      // No Flip To Do
00366             
00367             // Do Processing
00368             int offset = (partitionsDone + 1) << fftSizeHalvedLog2; // * fftSizeHalved;
00369             impulseTemp.realp = impulse.realp + offset;
00370             impulseTemp.imagp = impulse.imagp + offset;
00371             offset = nextPart << fftSizeHalvedLog2; // * fftSizeHalved;
00372             bufferTemp.realp = inputBufferSamples + offset; // InputBuffer.realp + Offset;
00373             bufferTemp.imagp = bufferTemp.realp + bufferSize; // InputBuffer.imagp + Offset;
00374             
00375             partitionsDone += numPartitionsToDo;
00376             
00377             for (int i = 0; i < numPartitionsToDo; i++) {   
00378                 MultAndAdd(bufferTemp, impulseTemp, fftTemp, fftSizeHalvedOver4);
00379                 impulseTemp.realp += fftSizeHalved;
00380                 impulseTemp.imagp += fftSizeHalved;
00381                 bufferTemp.realp += fftSizeHalved;
00382                 bufferTemp.imagp += fftSizeHalved;
00383             }
00384         }
00385         
00386         // Check that there is a new FFTs worth of buffer 
00387         
00388         if (tillNextFFT == 0)
00389         {           
00390             if (++validPart > Partitions) validPart = Partitions;
00391             
00392             // Calculate the position to put the FFT output into
00393             impulseTemp = impulse;
00394             const int offset = bufPosition << fftSizeHalvedLog2; // * fftSizeHalved;
00395             bufferTemp.realp = inputBufferSamples + offset; // InputBuffer.realp + Offset;
00396             bufferTemp.imagp = bufferTemp.realp + bufferSize; // InputBuffer.imagp + Offset;
00397             
00398             // Do the FFT, Process and Convert back with scaling
00399             tempvPointer1 = fftBuffers[fftOffset];
00400             fftEngine->fft(bufferTemp, (float*)tempvPointer1);
00401                         
00402             // Process First Partition Here (we need it now!)
00403             
00404             MultAndAdd(bufferTemp, impulseTemp, fftTemp, fftSizeHalved >> 2);
00405             
00406             if (--bufPosition < 0)
00407                 bufPosition = Partitions - 1;
00408             
00409             // Processing Done - Do Inverse FFT
00410             fftEngine->ifft((float*)fftBuffers[2], fftTemp);
00411                         
00412             // Overlap Save the Result
00413             loop = fftSize >> 3;
00414             int test = fftOffset;
00415             
00416             tempvPointer1 = fftBuffers[3] + (loop * (1 - test));
00417             tempvPointer2 = fftBuffers[3] + (loop * test);
00418             
00419             // post ifft scaling required by vDSP fft processes
00420             for (int i = 0; i < loop; i++)
00421                 *(tempvPointer1++) = VEC_MUL_OP(*(fftBuffers[2] + i), scaleMult ZEROARG);
00422             
00423             for (int i = loop; i < fftSize >> 2; i++) {
00424                 *(tempvPointer2) = VEC_ADD_OP(*(tempvPointer2), VEC_MUL_OP(*(fftBuffers[2] + i), scaleMult ZEROARG)); 
00425                 tempvPointer2++;
00426             }
00427             
00428             // Clear Buffer
00429             for (int i = 0; i < fftSizeHalved; i++) fftTemp.realp[i] = 0;
00430             for (int i = 0; i < fftSizeHalved; i++) fftTemp.imagp[i] = 0;
00431                         
00432             // Set wait till next data to hop time
00433             tillNextFFT = loop;
00434             
00435             // Reset RW_Pointers
00436             if (fftOffset) rwPointer1 = 0;
00437             else rwPointer2 = 0;
00438             fftOffset = 1 - fftOffset; // swaps between 0 and 1
00439             
00440             // Reset Schedule Stuff
00441             lastPart = bufPosition + 1;
00442             scheduleCounter = 0;
00443             partitionsDone = 0;
00444         }
00445     }
00446     
00447     LOCAL_COPY(bufPosition);
00448     LOCAL_COPY(fftOffset);
00449     LOCAL_COPY(tillNextFFT);
00450     LOCAL_COPY(rwPointer1);
00451     LOCAL_COPY(rwPointer2);
00452     
00453     LOCAL_COPY(partitionsDone);
00454     LOCAL_COPY(scheduleCounter);
00455     LOCAL_COPY(lastPart);
00456     LOCAL_COPY(validPart);
00457 }

00500 void TimeConvolveUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00501 {
00502     float *inputSamples = (float *)inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00503     float *outputSamples = (float *)uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00504     int numSamples = (int)uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00505     
00506     float *filter = filters.getData(channel);
00507     float *inputBufferSamples = ioBuffers.getData(TimeConvolveUGenInternal::InputBuffer);
00508     long position = this->position;
00509     long filterlength = filters.size();
00510     
00511     // N.B. Size of input_buf is always multiple of vectsize
00512     // We must be able to read out input in one go 
00513     // Copy input twice
00514     
00515     memcpy(inputBufferSamples + position, inputSamples, sizeof(float) * numSamples);
00516     memcpy(inputBufferSamples + 4096 + position, inputSamples, sizeof(float) * numSamples);
00517     
00518     position += numSamples;
00519     if (position >= 4096) position = 0;
00520     
00521     // Convolve Here
00522     
00523     vDSP_conv (inputBufferSamples + 4096 + position - (filterlength + numSamples) + 1, 1, 
00524                filter, 1, 
00525                outputSamples, 1, 
00526                numSamples, filterlength);
00527     
00528     this->position = position;  
00529 }
